+import os
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings"
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+
+
+def _normalize_input(text: str) -> str:
+    return text if text is not None else ""
+
+
+def embed_platform_output(text: str, api_key: str | None = None, model: str | None = None) -> List[float]:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    payload = {"input": _normalize_input(text), "model": model or OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["data"][0]["embedding"]
+
+
+def embed_platform_outputs(texts: Sequence[str], api_key: str | None = None, model: str | None = None) -> List[List[float]]:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    payload = {"input": [_normalize_input(text) for text in texts], "model": model or OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return [item["embedding"] for item in data["data"]]
+
*** End Patch

+import os

+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+
+
+def check_platform_output_safety(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": "omni-moderation-latest", "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    result = data["results"][0]
+    categories = result.get("categories", {})
+    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
+    unsafe_categories: List[str] = [name for name, flagged in categories.items() if flagged]
+    return {
+        "unsafe": bool(result.get("flagged")) or bool(unsafe_categories),
+        "unsafe_categories": unsafe_categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": "omni-moderation-latest",
+    }
+
+
+def is_safe(text: str) -> bool:
+    return not check_platform_output_safety(text)["unsafe"]

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: model_models.py
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Mapping, Optional
+
+
+def _first_present(data: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
+    for key in keys:
+        if key in data and data[key] is not None:
+            return data[key]
+    return None
+
+
+def _as_dict(value: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return dict(value)
+    return {}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ModelRequest:
+    model: str
+    input: Any
+    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_payload(cls, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "ModelRequest":
+        return cls(
+            model=str(_first_present(payload, "model", "model_id", "deployment", "deployment_id") or ""),
+            input=_first_present(payload, "input", "prompt", "messages", "data"),
+            parameters=_as_dict(_first_present(payload, "parameters", "params", "options")),
+            metadata=_as_dict(_first_present(payload, "metadata", "meta", "context")),
+        )
+
+    def to_payload(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": self.model, "input": self.input}
+        if self.parameters:
+            payload["parameters"] = dict(self.parameters)
+        if self.metadata:
+            payload["metadata"] = dict(self.metadata)
+        return payload
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ModelResponse:
+    id: str
+    model: str
+    output: Any
+    status: str = "succeeded"
+    usage: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_payload(cls, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "ModelResponse":
+        return cls(
+            id=str(_first_present(payload, "id", "request_id", "response_id") or ""),
+            model=str(_first_present(payload, "model", "model_id", "deployment", "deployment_id") or ""),
+            output=_first_present(payload, "output", "result", "data", "choices"),
+            status=str(_first_present(payload, "status", "state") or "succeeded"),
+            usage=_as_dict(_first_present(payload, "usage", "token_usage", "metrics")),
+            raw=dict(payload),
+        )
+
+    def to_payload(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "id": self.id,
+            "model": self.model,
+            "output": self.output,
+            "status": self.status,
+        }
+        if self.usage:
+            payload["usage"] = dict(self.usage)
+        if self.raw:
+            payload["raw"] = dict(self.raw)
+        return payload
+
+
+def normalize_request(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ModelRequest:
+    return ModelRequest.from_payload(payload)
+
+
+def normalize_response(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ModelResponse:
+    return ModelResponse.from_payload(payload)
+
+
+def normalize_workflow(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    request = normalize_request(_as_dict(_first_present(payload, "request", "input", "task", "job")))
+    response_payload = _as_dict(_first_present(payload, "response", "result", "output"))
+    response = normalize_response(response_payload) if response_payload else None
+    workflow: Dict[str, Any] = {
